nodes.description: Constructor of Bleach: sets fee wallets, seeds reflection balances for the contract and the dead address, and marks fee exclusions.
ERC20 transfer: calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom: calls _transfer and then _approve to reduce allowance.
ERC20 approve: calls _approve with _msgSender().
Internal _transfer: bot checks, buy cooldown via block.timestamp, max tx limit, fee selection and swap/send ETH branch.
Swaps contract-held tokens for ETH through the UniswapV2 router under the lockTheSwap modifier.
Splits contract ETH between _feeAddrWallet1 and _feeAddrWallet2 using .transfer().
Owner-only: installs router, creates pair, adds liquidity, enables swap/cooldown and sets max tx.
Manual swap entrypoint restricted by require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
Manual ETH distribution entrypoint restricted by require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
Owner-only: loops over an array and flags addresses as bots.
Owner-only: clears the bot flag for a single address.
Applies reflection accounting for a transfer, takes the team fee and reflects the fee.
Adds the reflection share of the team fee to the contract address balance.
Reduces _rTotal by rFee and increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
Internal approval: validates addresses and writes _allowances.
Owner-only toggle that sets cooldownEnabled.
Returns the token balance derived from _rOwned via tokenFromReflection.
Returns _allowances[owner][spender].
Converts a reflection amount to a token amount using _getRate.
Computes r/t transfer values from the stored fee settings and the current rate.
Computes the rSupply/tSupply ratio used for reflections.
Returns the current reflection supply and token supply values.
Ownable renounce function guarded by onlyOwner.
Mapping of reflection balances per address.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from fees.
Mapping marking addresses as blocked bots.
Mapping of per-address buy cooldown timestamps.
Total reflection supply, decremented by fees.
Accumulated token fee total.
Tax fee percentage applied on transfers.
Team fee percentage applied on transfers.
Payable fee wallet receiving half of collected ETH and authorizing manual functions.
Payable fee wallet receiving half of collected ETH.
UniswapV2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity.
Liquidity pair address for this token.
Reentrancy-style guard flag for the swap routine.
Flag enabling automatic token-to-ETH swapping.
Flag enabling the per-address buy cooldown.
Maximum transfer amount accepted from the pair.
Flag tracking whether trading has been opened.
Caller address obtained through _msgSender()/msg.sender.
Block timestamp used for cooldown checks and deadlines.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with caller-influenced token amount and deadline.
ETH .transfer() calls pushing balances to the two payable fee wallets.
External call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding the whole contract ETH balance.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer.
Token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount parameter of sendETHToFee.
Array of addresses parameter of setBots.
Reflection amount parameter of tokenFromReflection.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard.
Local holding balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
Local holding address(this).balance inside _transfer.
Local swap path array [token, WETH] inside swapTokensForEth.
Local rate returned by _getRate inside tokenFromReflection.
Local reflection supply read from _rTotal inside _getCurrentSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender via _msgSender().
msg.sender is used as spender when reducing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner in approve.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares to _msgSender().
setBots is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
block.timestamp controls the cooldown requirement and the cooldown write in _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_rOwned entries are debited and credited inside _transferStandard.
_rOwned[account] is converted by tokenFromReflection.
_rOwned[address(this)] is increased inside _takeTeam.
_rTotal is reduced by rFee in _reflectFee.
_tFeeTotal is increased by tFee in _reflectFee.
_feeAddr1 is consumed as taxFee when computing values.
_feeAddr2 is consumed as team fee when computing values.
_feeAddr1 feeds the transfer value computation in _transferStandard.
_feeAddr2 feeds the transfer value computation in _transferStandard.
bots[from] and bots[to] gate whether a transfer is allowed.
_isExcludedFromFee changes fee behaviour and the swap branch.
cooldown[to] is read and written based on block.timestamp.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown branch.
swapEnabled gates the swap-and-send branch.
inSwap prevents nested swapping inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds transfers originating from the pair.
uniswapV2Router address is compared against the recipient in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is used to detect buy and sell directions.
Allowance entry is read and subtracted in transferFrom.
Allowance entry is returned by the allowance view.
_approve writes into _allowances.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the forwarded ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the forwarded ETH.
uniswapV2Router is invoked for the token swap.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and used inside openTrading.
uniswapV2Pair is assigned and approved inside openTrading.
_rTotal is the reflection supply used by _getRate.
_rTotal is read inside _getCurrentSupply.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
approve delegates execution to _approve.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth while transfer state is still being processed.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee to forward collected ETH.
sendETHToFee executes ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
_transfer finishes by handing off to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth directly.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee directly.
openTrading performs the addLiquidityETH external call.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflected fee.
_transferStandard obtains transfer values via _getValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_takeTeam calls _getRate.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address.
The external swap call can re-enter the transfer logic while state is mid-update.
A fee wallet contract receiving ETH can re-enter manualsend.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists as the sender of _transfer and should be folded into that core function.
The to parameter only exists as the recipient of _transfer and should be folded into that core function.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be merged into it.
tokenAmount is the sole input of swapTokensForEth and belongs to that core function.
The amount parameter is only used by sendETHToFee and should be merged into it.
bots_ is the array iterated by setBots and should be folded into that core function.
rAmount is the only input of tokenFromReflection and should be merged into it.
tAmount is the transfer amount processed by _transferStandard and belongs to it.
The local balance is only used as the swap amount passed to swapTokensForEth.
The local ETH balance is only used as the amount passed to sendETHToFee.
The path array is constructed only for the router swap performed by swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is a temporary produced by _getRate and used only inside tokenFromReflection.
rSupply is a temporary initialized from _rTotal inside _getCurrentSupply.
